title: Fragmentation and dynamics of dense gas structures in the proximity of massive young stellar object W42-MME
question: How do dense gas structures around the MYSO W42-MME fragment and what are their dynamics (turbulence, virial state, infall) from core to sub-parsec scales?

data.bands: Band 7 (line and 865 um continuum); 1.35 mm continuum for large-area view

what.value: ALMA 865 um continuum map and data reduction

evidence.quote: we have utilized the ALMA continuum data at 865 $\mu$m ($\nu\sim$346.5 GHz) from (cite: Dewangan2022)

key_parameters: min_value = 3 sigma = 7 mJy/beam; min_delta = 1 sigma = 2.3 mJy/beam; min_npix = 74 pixels

recipe.method: Rotation diagram of K=0-4 lines on averaged spectra per structure; T=-1/slope
Optically thin dust mass from 865 um flux; virial mass with density profile and geometry factors; sigma_nt from sigma_obs minus thermal
key_parameters: kappa = 10 (nu/1.2 THz)^1.5 -> 1.55 cm2/g at 346.58 GHz; rho ~ r^-1.6; mu=30 (H13CO), 2.37 for c_s
assumptions: gas-to-dust ratio 100; spherical symmetry; distance 3.8 kpc

recipe.method: Asymmetry parameter A=(Vthick-Vthin)/DeltaVthin from Gaussian fits to leaf-averaged HCO+ lines

recipe.goal: Scaling relations and velocity structure function
recipe.method: Power-law fits of dV-L, sigma_nt-L, M-R, n-R with Pearson correlation; second-order VSF from moment-1 map
key_parameters: VSF uses pixels with peak > 0.01 Jy/beam and FWHM < 2.5 km/s (7566 points)

recipe.method: Dendrogram on 865 um map, then masses and virial parameters

evidence.quote: Our results reveal 19 dense gas structures, out of which 12 are leaves and 7 are branches
The temperature estimates for leaf structures ranged from 33 to 70 K, with the mean (median) values of 54.27 (61.84) K
The analysis resulted in the identification of 14 cores.

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version, calibration and imaging parameters (in Dewangan2022)
Spectral channel width and cube velocity resolution used for dendrogram
Primary beam correction and continuum subtraction details
Fitting method for power laws and line profile Gaussians
Which dendrogram structures lacked temperatures and what T was adopted for them in mass
missing_for_reproduction: Calibrated cubes and continuum reduction details (in Dewangan2022)
score_reason: Public data and well-specified dendrogram parameters, but reduction and fitting details are deferred or missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, explicit dendrogram parameters and numeric results.
